newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania c.bank reserves rise to $1.966 bln in June.
newsitem.headline: Romania c.bank reserves rise to $1.966 bln in June.

text.p: Central bank (BNR) total foreign exchange reserves climbed to $1.966 billion at end-June from $1.495 billion at end-May as the BNR continued to mop up excess dollars from the market, BNR data showed on Monday.

The 31.5 percent growth in the reserves was also a result of a raising in mark-denominated Eurobonds, an IMF loan tranche and a loan package from the World Bank, a BNR official said, without elaborating.
Over the past few months, the BNR has drained from the market large hard currency inflows resulting from the growing foreign interest in Romanian equities and securities.
The BNR soaked up the dollars to prevent a leu rise which would have harmed exporters.
Earlier this year, BNR governor Mugur Isarescu said the reserves were expected to soar to $3 billion at the end of 1997.
The leu has been relatively stable near 7,100 to the dollar in recent weeks, recovering strongly from a record low of 9,000 in mid-February.
BNR data also showed foreign reserve assets in the banking system had risen slightly to $3.27 billion in May from $3.17 billion in April. Figures for June reserve assets were not available.
End-May reserve assets included gold reserves worth $992.7 million, Special Drawing Rights and hard currency reserves of local banks and of the BNR. ($=7,103 lei)
